The '''Baobab Archives Cultural Phenomenon Study Center''' was a division of the [[Baobab Archives]]. Studying cultural trends across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the Center paid particular attention to tourism and business travel.<ref name="Travel Book">[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']]</ref>
